rootCause.capturedMismatch: Host div.page-enter is compared against its own inner Suspense comment after its Flight lazy child becomes fulfilled during hydration replay.
rootCause.confirmedMechanism: The installed renderer replays the suspended host fiber without restoring the hydration cursor. Identical markup fails deterministically with the actual pre-repair PageTransition source; a component fiber can replay without claiming the wrapper again.
rootCause.repair: Resolve the route child inside a private PageContent component. No DOM, fallback, dependency upgrade, delay, retry or warning suppression.
rootCause.recoveryEffects: Court is still off at the captured throw point. Later head rebuilding and root attribute loss are recovery fallout, not evidence that the ambient script caused the mismatch.
rootCause.correlationOnly: Earlier head chunk removal is a timing correlation; no evidence establishes it as the cause.
rootCause.historicalLimit: The original exploratory collector lacked event stack, timestamp and exact URL. These new localized failures do not reconstruct that missing evidence or prove the original event had precisely this cause.

productionLocalization.instrumentation: Observer inserted only at the production throw point; captures fiber/cursor fields. No DOM mutation, suppression or scheduler modification. It may affect timing; deterministic scheduler evidence independently verifies the replay mechanism.
